about: Karen music video re-cut, round 1 (Claude, 2026-11-05). Every shot is [clip id, beats, in-point seconds (optional), why]. Beats come from song-map.json; a section's last shot fills to the section end. Verses/intro/bridge/outro = photo pool, choruses/break = cartoon pool (Kai's rule). Ids: catalogue.json, plus c01..c14 = the new cartoon clips (new-cartoon-shots.md).

intro: god's-eye Manhattan, slow rise, under the phone menu
tower windows light into a telephone
cubicle farm, one woman on the phone
receptionist answers ('press three to speak to an adviser')
verse-1: 'Monday, nine-oh-five, a chair and a flask'
Karen in the payphone from a passing cab
'fetch me the desk that sits behind the desk'
the file travels up the hall
'nothing further I can do at this level'
pre-chorus-1: 'put down the script' a clerk hangs up
'pick up the phone' an official picks up
Karen ranting, push in, into the hit
chorus-1: HIT: the booth in the rain
the cubicle grid (first half only: it morphs later)
'all day to complain' the booth, the desk phone
verse-2: 'Regional office, Thursday. Rain on the glass.'
'Borough office, Tuesday, they gave me a code'
'a caseworker will call you' (blinking phone, empty chair)
'he thinks I'll just throw in the towel'
'State house, Friday, the good hold' day into night
pre-chorus-2: 'pick up the phone' the suited hand, her file
Karen, push in to her face, into the hit
chorus-2: 'You'll have to wait in line' hold music
break: the spy riff: Karen under the lamp
back to the booth as it drops away
bridge: 'Six weeks in a phone box on Lexington and Third' day into night
'sun again, and not one word' clouds roll in
'here's the part they never printed in the manual'
verse-3: 'Deputy Secretary. Somebody's aide's aide.' the heavy door
'this line is for emergencies' — 'look what I made'
'Chief of Staff at midnight' the empty boardroom
final-chorus: HIT, crash cymbal: the dome, dark
'I'm sorry, I can't help you' the room of voices
outro: every phone in the chain at once
Karen at dusk, on the line
Karen on the ferry, the skyline, the held chord
out over the courthouse to the last hit
